title: Random loot storm stuff
description: Add a lot of new things and mechanicanicls, also it's ports enderites  equipment on 1.21.1 neoforge (unofficially)
body: 🌌 **Random loot storm stuff** - _Enderite Expansion & Mechanics_ (Unofficial NeoForge 1.21.1 Port)This modification completely reimagines and expands the concept of Enderite in Minecraft, turning it into the ultimate late-game tier. Since the original version of the mod was completely broken and refused to launch in modern modpacks, this unofficial port for NeoForge 1.21.1 was created to fix those issues while massively expanding the core gameplay.This is not a simple code copy. The mod now features a vast amount of brand-new items, unique mechanics, and advanced features that elevate your End-dimension survival.🛠️ New Features & MechanicsThe mod goes far beyond basic armor and tools, introducing a deep progression system:Void-Defying Mechanics: Enderite equipment now possesses unique physical properties. It is completely immune to explosions, fire, and lava. Most importantly, it floats in the Void and teleports back to a safe surface or directly to the player upon death.Advanced Technological Components: Added Enderite alloys, energy cores, and conductive plates used for high-tier crafting recipes in industrial setups.Expanded Arsenal: Introducing multi-tools (paxels), heavy warhammers with AOE knockback, and Enderite shields that absorb damage and reflect projectles back at attackers.Magical Artifacts: Craftable rings and amulets that grant permanent status effects like Slow Falling, Night Vision, or complete immunity to Shulker levitation.🚀 Port Details & Disclaimer (Important Notice)Please read the following information regarding the nature of this release:NeoForge 1.21.1 Compatibility: Fully rewritten and optimized for the latest NeoForge libraries. Tested and verified to work within heavy modpacks.The Launch Fix: The original mod suffered from critical rendering conflicts and registry errors that crashed modern game instances. This version resolves those conflicts entirely.Strict Disclaimer:This is an unofficial port. The original authors are not involved in this release.The newly added content and mechanic rebalances were developed independently for this specific build.The creator of this port bears absolutely no responsibility for any bugs, performance issues, mod conflicts, or world corruption. Use this software entirely at your own risk.🔮 Future PlansIntegration with major tech mods for automated Enderite ore processing.Custom Enderite-infused machinery and transport pipes.A new End-dimension mini-boss holding rare upgrade templates.
